open_points.subject: OwnerSession pending confirmation disclosure
open_points.text: `business_confidential` covers “the owner session, but for its uploaded import file”, while M11 says a pending confirmation carries “the inputs it is bound to”
open_points.question: When confirmation inputs contain project display names, customer data, object data or other imported personal values, does the pending confirmation store those values, making those facts `personal_data`, or only a non-personal reference or digest?
options: Store the input values and classify those pending-confirmation facts as `personal_data`
Store only a reference or digest and keep the pending confirmation `business_confidential`
Forbid personal values from confirmation-bound inputs
open_points.default_guess: Store only a reference or digest to the uploaded file and keep the pending confirmation `business_confidential`.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession last-request instant
open_points.text: “the instant of its last request” is changed by requests, but Revisions and times says “Every other model carries only the written-once instants its own facts name”
open_points.question: Is OwnerSession an exception that carries a mutable instant, or must the last-request instant be removed or represented outside the model?
options: Make OwnerSession an explicit exception with a mutable last-request instant
Remove the last-request instant from OwnerSession
Represent request activity outside OwnerSession
open_points.default_guess: Make OwnerSession an explicit exception with a mutable last-request instant.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession last-request mutation
open_points.text: “changed by the owner's requests (State 2 A13, A16)”
open_points.question: Which requests change the last-request instant: every authenticated request, only owner-interface page and form requests, only successful requests, or some stated subset?
options: Every authenticated request in the session, successful or refused
Only successful authenticated owner-interface requests
Only the future A13 and A16 actions
A separately enumerated subset
open_points.default_guess: Every authenticated owner-interface request that resolves to the session, whether successful or refused.

open_points.subject: Pending confirmation one-time value and confirmation id
open_points.text: M11 has a pending confirmation with “its one-time value” made when the step is shown, while Identity formats says Registry mints “a confirmation id when the owner confirms” and M11 says it “is minted per confirmation”
open_points.question: Are the pending one-time value and the audited confirmation id the same identifier; if so, is it minted when the step is shown or when the action is confirmed, and if not, who mints the one-time value and what relationship do the two identifiers have?
options: They are the same identifier, minted when the confirmation step is shown
They are the same identifier, minted only when confirmation is submitted
They are distinct values: a pending token minted when shown and an audit confirmation id minted when accepted
open_points.default_guess: Treat them as distinct: Registry mints a one-time pending token when showing the step and a confirmation id when the confirmed action is accepted.

open_points.subject: Pending confirmation lifecycle after an attempted use
open_points.text: the pending confirmation is “cleared when used”
open_points.question: Does submitting the one-time value clear the pending confirmation even when the value is wrong, the bound revision or access version is stale, the target has changed, or the confirmed action is otherwise refused, or only when the action is accepted?
options: Clear it on every submission attempt
Clear it only after an accepted confirmed action
Clear it for valid-token submissions even when the bound action is refused
open_points.default_guess: Clear it whenever the correct one-time value is submitted, even if the bound action is then refused.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession uploaded import file action
open_points.text: “at most one uploaded import file, replaced by the next upload and dropped when the import is accepted”
open_points.question: Is uploading the migration file a distinct owner product action that stores or replaces the session fact, and does the confirmed import always read the current file from that same session rather than receiving a file again?
options: A distinct upload action stores the file; confirmed import reads the session's current file
The import action itself uploads the file; there is no separate upload action
Both separate upload and file-on-import are allowed
open_points.default_guess: Use a distinct authenticated upload action and have the confirmed import read that session's current uploaded file.

open_points.subject: Uploaded import file after refused or abandoned import
open_points.text: the uploaded file is “dropped when the import is accepted” and “Everything in it ends with the session”
open_points.question: What happens to the uploaded file when import is refused, its confirmation is abandoned or replaced, or the owner cancels the attempt before the session ends?
options: Keep it until replaced, accepted or the session ends
Drop it after every import attempt, accepted or refused
Drop it when its pending confirmation is replaced or cancelled
Provide an explicit owner action to discard it
open_points.default_guess: Keep it after a refused or abandoned attempt until it is replaced, successfully imported, explicitly discarded, or the session ends.

open_points.subject: Interaction between an import confirmation and a replacement upload
open_points.text: a pending confirmation is “bound to” its inputs, while the uploaded file is “replaced by the next upload”
open_points.question: If the owner uploads another file after an import confirmation has been shown, does that upload clear or replace the pending confirmation, leave it bound to the now-removed old file, or retarget it to the new file?
options: Uploading a new file clears the pending import confirmation
The confirmation remains bound to the old file, which must therefore remain available
The confirmation is automatically rebound to the new file
A new upload is refused while an import confirmation is pending
open_points.default_guess: Uploading a new file clears the pending import confirmation; the owner must review and confirm the new file separately.
